extraction_notes: PDF SHA-256 verified as 1e0a5e7f1410f8cedd935f9711eb906e1aabcb0946f3777ed45209516a9cb958 before extraction.

Identity verified: the supplied PDF names LMBT3946DW1T1G and S-LMBT3946DW1T1G, identifies the device as dual general-purpose PNP/NPN silicon transistors, and names Leshan Radio Company, LTD. (LRC). The requested exact MPN is LMBT3946DW1T1G and LCSC is C136169.
The supplied PDF has eight pages and states Rev.B Mar 2016 in the footer. Pages 1 through 8 were examined.

This schema permits one polarity only. The specs and curves in this object record the NPN section of the dual PNP/NPN device; the separately published PNP electrical table and PNP curves are not representable without adding unsupported schema properties.

NPN electrical characteristics are headed Ta = 25 degC. Guaranteed hFE minimum and maximum semantics, VCE(sat) maximums, VBE(sat) maximums, fT minimum, Cobo maximum, Cibo maximum, and VBR(CEO) minimum are preserved from p. 3; no typical table values were substituted.

NPN characteristic plots on pages 4 and 5 were manually digitized at visible axis positions. Curve values are approximate direct read-offs in SI units; no interpolation was used. Curves retain their logarithmic or linear axis scales and stated conditions.

The NPN pages publish typical curves at -55 degC, 25 degC, and 150 degC, but only the clearly read 25 degC traces are included here. The collector saturation-region plot does not state a temperature and is omitted from curves rather than assigned one.

No numeric Early voltage is published, and absolute ratings other than the represented VBR(CEO) row are not represented by this schema. The p. 1 maximum ratings additionally state NPN VCEO = 40 V, VCBO = 60 V, VEBO = 6 V, IC = 200 mA, PD = 150 mW, and TJ/Tstg = -55 to +150 degC.
extraction.omission_reason: The supplied part contains both NPN and PNP sections, while this schema permits one polarity only; this object records the NPN section. VAF is not numerically published, and additional absolute-rating fields are not represented by the schema.
